limitations: This is a nucleolar ribosome precursor assembly, not a mature translating cytoplasmic ribosome.
The post-A1 conformation is one state in a maturation pathway.
Keep unidentified peptide regions unidentified; do not assign invented protein identities.
Requires chunking and strict geometry budgets; do not construct hundreds of thousands of Python atom spheres for every displayed processome.
Processome constituents overlap with ribosomal-protein and RNA populations; avoid double counting.
